name: Acurus
summary: Melbourne tech/IT services company; began as utility billing/IT consulting, later built the Anex ISP white-label broadband platform; acquired by Superloop (ACURUS HOLDINGS PTY LTD, ACN 168 039 245).

events.details: Founded in Melbourne by Marshall Thompson and Jason Matser (utility billing platforms and IT consulting); founding predates the archive, earliest Wayback capture 1 Feb 2012 (holding company ACURUS HOLDINGS PTY LTD registered 13 Feb 2014).
